response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with nearly two decades of hands-on experience, but he does not match the profile for this Director-level Principal Engineer AI Strategy role. He lacks the ~15 years combined with recognized AI expertise, has no advanced degree in an AI field, no demonstrated AI products/platforms, and no evidence of advising strategic customers or shaping cloud/AI strategy at an organizational level — his experience is almost entirely execution-focused rather than strategic/advisory.
strengths: Broad, deep technical versatility across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure engineering
Long tenure (~17 years) with consistent hands-on delivery and craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Some recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic workflows) at current role
concerns: No advanced degree or specialization in AI/ML; only a general CS bachelor's
No track record of building recognized AI products/platforms or advising strategic external customers
Career trajectory is IC/craftsman-focused, not strategy or director-level leadership as required

key_factors.factor: No strategic/customer-advisory or director-level leadership experience
Strong general engineering breadth and experience
